bio: Set against the backdrop of the Allgäu Alps, this hotel has tasteful, comfortable guestrooms and a lovely, inviting restaurant in which cosy Alpine vibes meet elegant table settings. Affording stunning views, the terrace is a wonderful spot for a meal in summer! The menu is varied: at lunchtime (from 1pm) there is a three-course set menu and à la carte dishes, including small bites to share; in the evening the selection includes their Signature Menu, as well as dishes ranging from braised vegetable ravioli to lobster, and venison loin to Gröstl (pan-fried potatoes). The extensive wine list encompasses a fine selection....
